composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: if the request's 'Idempotency-Key' was already recorded by a previous
# successful create, replay the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
# No header (or a new key) falls through to the normal create pipeline. The key -> owner id
# lookup is in-memory, so this step needs no transaction.
check:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    replay: respondReplay
    proceed: validate

respondReplay:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithReplayedOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRequiredOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (four digits, in-range for the city's region).
# A malformed or out-of-range postcode is a 400 here, before any persistence work.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400). Optional field: when
# absent it is not checked and defaults to the server date on build.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Single consolidated duplicate check: the whole identityKey (SHA-256 hex over normalized
# telephone, lower-cased email and soundex(lastName)) must not equal any existing owner's.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityBelowCapacity

ensureCityBelowCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityBelowCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureBelowDailyLimit

ensureBelowDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureBelowDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHouseholdMembers

countHouseholdMembers:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# A new owner's membershipLevel cannot exceed one above the current maximum membershipLevel among
# existing members of their household. With no existing household member no cap applies. Runs after
# the namesake/household counts it derives the level from and before save so the capped level persists.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate: not a hard duplicate (that already 409'd), but a differing identityKey whose
# soundex(lastName) and postcode match an existing owner's. Recorded on the owner, not rejected.
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: enqueueWelcome

# Enqueue the welcome notification: a NOTIFY log line carrying the owner id and memberId.
# Runs after save (owner id populated).
enqueueWelcome:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: evaluateBulkSignupWarning

evaluateBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EvaluateBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: evaluateCapacityWarning

evaluateCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EvaluateCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Record key -> created owner id so a later repeat of the same 'Idempotency-Key' replays this
# owner. Runs after save (owner id populated); a request with no key records nothing.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On the response this is
            the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The structured first line of the postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional structured second line of the postal address. When present it is
            stored and returned normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present
            it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode); it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the
            household link — the householdId is always derived from last name and postcode.
            Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as title + ' ' + lastName when a
                title is supplied, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where
                REGION is the owner's locality/region, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the
                registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized telephone and lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed
                over the decimal digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts

## Summary

Implemented the `riskFlag` response field on owners: **true when any of** the owner is a possible duplicate, the email domain is disposable-adjacent, or the city is over its soft capacity — otherwise false.

Since these three signals were already computed elsewhere in the pipeline, `riskFlag` is a purely derived response field (like `ownerSegment`, `membershipPoints`, etc.), computed at mapping time so it works for both `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

Changes:
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `riskFlag` boolean to the `OwnerDto` schema (so the generated DTO carries it).
- **`OwnerMapper`** — added `@Mapping(target = "riskFlag", expression = RiskFlag.of(owner))`.
- **`util/RiskFlag.java`** (new) — OR of the three signals:
  - possible duplicate → the entity's existing `possibleDuplicate` flag,
  - disposable-adjacent email → `DisposableDomains.isAdjacent(email)`,
  - over soft capacity → the entity's existing `capacityWarning` transient (city already holds ≥ 40 owners, the soft threshold below the hard cap of 50).
- **`util/DisposableDomains.java`** (new) — single source of truth for the disposable blocklist plus the *adjacency* rule: a domain not itself blocked but sharing its second-level label with a blocked domain (different TLD like `mailinator.net`, or a subdomain like `smtp.mailinator.com`).
